images.clustering: None; only 2 isolated vessels in the whole box.
images.notes: q4: red-hulled vessel (~10-12 px) about 2 km SSE of the southern Quoin islet, with its wake trailing NNW, so it is heading SSE (outbound). q3 (~470,725): bright ~10 px vessel with a long wake trailing SSW, so it is heading NNE; that is not clearly NW or SE, so it is not given a heading. q4: a long straight bright wake from about (680,930) runs SE to the bottom tile edge, but no hull is visible, so it is not counted. q4 (~100,740): a faint short linear streak, possibly a small boat wake, not counted. Lots of slicks/surface-film lines and some glint in q3, but the water is readable.

Only vessel: red-hulled ~10 px ship SSE of the southern Quoin islet (q4 ~570,900), almost the same spot as on 08-07, with no clear wake, so counted stationary. q3 has bright streaky features (probably thin cloud or glint on slicks) despite the 0% mask. q1 bottom edge has odd bright shapes, treated as artefacts. Faint speckles in q4 (~1050-1190, 930-950) and q3 bottom (~1060-1150, 1140-1180) may be small boats or whitecaps; not counted. q4 east edge has small cloud patches.

Cloud looks much higher than the 2.37% mask: q2 is about 35% covered by broken cumulus and shadow, q4 has a large cloud in the bottom-centre plus scattered cumulus to the east, and there is some in q1's NE corner. Red-hulled ~10 px vessel at q4 (~558,818), slightly NW of its earlier positions, with a faint short trace to the NW, so read as heading SE (wake detection uncertain). Possible tiny bright marks with linear traces at q3 (~1110,930), q4 (~50,285) and q2 (~820,860); too small or uncertain, not counted. The bright patches in q1 SW and q3 NW are slick or glint features, not vessels.

Haze over the west half of q1 and q3, and broken cloud in q3's west and SW. q4: red-hulled ~10 px vessel at (~545,815) with a long linear wake trailing WNW, so it is heading ESE (outbound). q1 (~560,740): ~8 px vessel with a long wake trailing SSW, so it is heading NNE (direction not clearly NW or SE). q1 (~925,603): small vessel (~4 px) with its wake trailing east, heading W. q2 (~805,545): small vessel (~3-4 px) with its wake trailing WNW, heading ESE. Possible tiny marks at q3 (~40,550) in haze, q4 (~440,48) and q4 (~1430,1108); not counted.

summary.qualitative: Traffic was extremely light in all four images. No large vessels (150 m or more) were seen; each image had only 1-2 medium vessels and a few small craft. A red-hulled medium vessel appears near the southern Quoin islet in every image, moving on 3 of the 4 dates. There are no queues, anchorage clusters or groups of stationary ships. Moving share uses only large and medium vessels (5 of 6 had wakes), and the image 3 wake is uncertain.
